proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.on_hit_loses_magic
proposed_widenings.justification: The item fits as passive rarity-scaled attack and damage bonuses, but the surface cannot express a magic item's bonus ending after it hits a target without treating the item as destroyed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it hits a target, the ammunition is no longer magical.
